I normally don't link to facebook groups, but Ed Lipsett has released these old school, system-neutral rulebooks into the public domain (100 alien races, 1,000 alien creatures, and some 200 worlds)

All of these rules are in the files section of the group. Feel free to download. The only thing we ask in return is that you come back and talk about the rules, and your experiences with them.

PS Please note that these rules contain a conversion system for original D&D, and thus, for retroclone games as well.
